title: Housing and Spatial Planning — measured pilot

ownership.note: Directory host association plus observed trusted redirect and institutional identity. Legacy portfolio titles in directories may differ; no endorsement implied.

conditions: Sequential Lighthouse 13.5.0 / Chrome 153 laboratory runs, up to three declared attempts per each of 3 predeclared pages on mobile and desktop; default simulated throttling and fresh browser processes. Per-pair successful-run counts and any unattempted runs are explicit; a collection stop is not a website failure. Operator network/geography unverified. Guarded DOM/axe observations use GET/HEAD and four-request concurrency; excluded requests can change rendering. No forms submitted, physical devices, field INP, full security audit, complete service process or 28-day reliability claim. Independent review pending. Different page samples are not a national comparison.
collectionNotes: 18 timing attempts recorded of 18 planned; 0 unattempted after collection limits.
3 distinct predeclared core page(s), with three attempts per page/device. Missing roles and narrower samples are not equivalent to complete website coverage.
homepage: guarded observation gaps retained; normal-browser follow-up is separate.
contact: guarded observation gaps retained; normal-browser follow-up is separate.
The contact-page DOM contains an email/address heading, but the initial mobile screenshot does not establish its visible availability. Contact-channel credit is withheld pending a specific follow-up.
An external embedded document is excluded by the collector. Its blocked rendering is not scored as an intrinsic broken resource or a ministry outage.
No housing eligibility rule was independently verified as current, and no form, payment, purchase request or application was submitted.

Completion review 2026-10-26 of the 21 October follow-up: 6 previously unmeasured criteria resolved, adding 8 assessed budget points. 3/3 additional core-page follow-ups were representative; excluded captures and original attempts are retained. Prior valid timing samples are unchanged. 35 criteria remain unmeasured; see the completion record for required evidence.

Supplementary GET search tasks, where present, use observed search forms and do not expand the original Lighthouse timing sample. Retained visual comparison is explicitly distinguished from fresh capture. Collector connection failures, robots exclusions and incomplete responses are never website zeros.

Coverage revision 2026-10-28: 2 further criteria resolved using explicit reviewed evidence. Restricted, untested and monitoring-dependent criteria remain unmeasured. Scores and measurement coverage are different quantities; no conversion of missing evidence to passes or zeros.

findings.title: Mobile homepage loading
findings.detail: Median lab LCP 9.58 seconds, range 8.71–9.86 seconds across three successful simulated runs. This operator-network result is not a field percentile or every visitor's experience.

findings.title: Clarify the currency of housing guidance
findings.detail: The rental-housing sample combines application guidance with historic purchase/transfer deadlines ending in 2015. Separate historical provisions and show when current instructions were last reviewed.

categories.label: External Security Posture and Technical Privacy

rows.label: HTTPS enforced
rows.reason: The declared HTTP entry upgraded to trusted HTTPS without an observed downgrade. Credit is limited to this captured entry chain.

rows.label: Valid TLS certificate
rows.reason: Normal hostname/chain/date-verified HTTPS succeeded on every declared core page. This does not enumerate supported protocols or ciphers.

rows.label: Modern TLS configuration
rows.reason: Insufficient verified evidence for the complete criterion: Full protocol/cipher assessment, not one negotiated connection. Untested steps and constrained observations remain unmeasured, not passed or failed.

rows.label: HSTS present and meaningful
rows.reason: Captured HSTS policies were parsed against the frozen rule: full requires max-age at least one year with includeSubDomains; a valid positive narrower policy earns half; absent, disabled or malformed earns zero. Worst declared page governs.

rows.label: Content-Security-Policy present and meaningful
rows.reason: Reviewed the retained successful document response headers together with the same-capture HTTP-equiv meta policies: at least one declared page has neither an enforcing Content-Security-Policy header nor a CSP meta policy. That verified absence prevents meaningful-policy credit for the sample; it does not demonstrate an exploitable vulnerability.

rows.label: Other important security headers
rows.reason: Reviewed nosniff, DENY/SAMEORIGIN or restrictive frame-ancestors, and explicit meaningful Referrer-Policy values. Full needs all three protections, half some, zero none; worst sampled page governs.

rows.label: Secure cookie configuration
rows.reason: Only attributes of observed cookies are reviewed. Full requires Secure, HttpOnly and explicit Lax/Strict on all; partial means mixed protections. No names/values or complete consent/tracking audit are published.

rows.label: No mixed HTTP/HTTPS content
rows.reason: Insufficient verified evidence for the complete criterion: Browser and sampled-page evidence. Untested steps and constrained observations remain unmeasured, not passed or failed.

rows.label: No unnecessary software/version exposure
rows.reason: The retained public response headers or generator metadata explicitly disclose WordPress 7.1.3. One verified disclosure prevents full or partial absence credit for the declared sample. This is an information-disclosure observation, not evidence that this version is vulnerable or unsupported.

rows.label: No obvious sensitive configuration exposure
rows.reason: Insufficient verified evidence for the complete criterion: Passive eligible-page review only; no guessed sensitive paths. Untested steps and constrained observations remain unmeasured, not passed or failed.

rows.label: Forms usable on mobile
rows.reason: Manually reviewed the fresh 28 October full-page screenshots at 320/390/844 CSS px with the field geometry/type records. The sampled comment form shows readable labels, appropriately typed email/URL fields, a message area and a submit control within each tested viewport. This covers the comment interface, not a housing application service. Credit is limited to the sampled pre-submission mobile interface. No data was entered, file uploaded, CAPTCHA solved, form submitted, physical keyboard certified, error recovery tested or service completed.

rows.reason: The housing guidance title and description accurately explain public rental housing. The homepage duplicates the ministry name in its title, while the contact document has an empty description. Partial credit reflects this uneven three-page metadata quality.

rows.reason: Insufficient verified evidence for the complete criterion: robots.txt and sitemap.xml observations. Untested steps and constrained observations remain unmeasured, not passed or failed.

rows.label: Clean URLs, canonicalization and redirects
rows.reason: Manually compared all three retained 21 October representative page URLs with their actual canonical tags and the captured HTTP-entry redirect. Each page declares its corresponding same-site HTTPS canonical destination; the entry upgrades to HTTPS without a downgrade. Percent-encoding case differences do not change the destination. Housing's stable content-ID query URLs are not penalized for being query URLs. Full credit covers this declared sample, not arbitrary aliases, every parameter or verified search-engine indexing.

rows.label: Functional site search and discoverability
rows.reason: Opened an actually observed same-origin GET search form with the benign Arabic keyword وزارة. The captured 200 response identifies the query and presents relevant matching results, including housing-ministry cooperation and ministerial news. Reviewed the result text rather than inferring functionality from the input. Credit is for this one successful query, not all search terms or every result destination.

rows.label: No critically outdated public technology
rows.reason: Insufficient verified evidence for the complete criterion: Passive fingerprint plus verified support status. Untested steps and constrained observations remain unmeasured, not passed or failed.

rows.label: Cross-page technical consistency
rows.reason: The retained contact page has a failed embedded panel while homepage and housing guidance render content in the shared template. Partial technical consistency. An unavailable embed is not evidence that the entire website is unavailable.

manual.scope: Implementing-evaluator review limited to row-specific evidence on 3 declared pages. Normal-browser dimensions and initial Tab paths are recorded; this is not a completed keyboard/menu or assistive-technology review.
